I Asked a Privacy Lawyer What Facebook's New Terms and Conditions Will Mean for You

The new terms will require users to accept a new location data policy that says you allow Facebook to use your GPS, Bluetooth, and wi-fi signals to track your location.

So while it is Big-Brotherish, users have agreed to this by agreeing to use Facebook. The reality is that users would prefer to allow Facebook to use their data in any way than to switch to another social media platform.

Would people switch if there was a viable alternative that didn't profile and spy on people, but instead relied on non-targeted ads, donations, and paid perks?
